visual_description: A medium shot in a bright, modern classroom at Immortal Sect Fifth High School. Sunlight streams through a large window, illuminating dust motes in the air. Chen Mobai, a handsome young man with a slight smirk, holds a glowing jade-like smartphone, displaying 'Fifth-Stage Qi Refinement' on its screen. His deskmate leans in, eyes wide with a mix of surprise and envy, a flush of indignation coloring his face. Desks are arranged neatly, and other blurred students are visible in the background, subtly suggesting the ongoing class. The art style is clean and vibrant, like a Chinese Manhua panel.
text_segment:
In a classroom by the window at Immortal Sect Fifth High School in Danxia City, a handsome young man pulled out his slim, jade-like smartphone and opened his personal interface to update his data.
With the new semester just beginning, the homeroom teacher was checking each student's cultivation progress during the holiday break. Chen Mobai edited the necessary updates.
After connecting to the school's network, he was about to submit his personal panel to the teacher when a voice came from beside him.
"Whoa, you actually went into secluded cultivation during the holiday and broke through to the Fifth-Stage Qi Refinement?"
His deskmate, having already submitted his own panel, glanced at Chen Mobai's screen and noticed the "Fifth-Stage Qi Refinement" entry in the cultivation realm field. A hint of envy tinged his voice.
Although the information on personal profiles was self-reported, the school could easily verify its accuracy through various exams. Few students dared to falsify their records, as being caught would result in a permanent mark on their file, impacting future academic advancement and even wartime deployment.
Within the Immortal Sect, the penalties for deception were particularly severe.
"We're not the same, you know," Chen Mobai said, a hint of smugness in his voice. "I have a True Spiritual Root. If I focus and work hard, my cultivation progress will undoubtedly be much faster than yours with that Pseudo Spiritual Root."
Over the vacation, aside from being dragged to the temple by his mother to burn incense, Chen Mobai had remained secluded at home, cultivating diligently. With the aid of medicinal pills, he had finally broken through his bottleneck and advanced to Fifth-Stage Qi Refinement.
"How can your Spiritual Root attributes qualify as a True Spiritual Root? It's so unfair!" his classmate exclaimed, his face flushed with indignation. But there was nothing he could do; such were the Immortal Sect's regulations.
A Spiritual Root with an attribute score exceeding 20 was considered to possess that attribute. During his time in the womb, fate had seemingly divided his talents too evenly across four attributes, classifying him as having a Pseudo Spiritual Root.
In reality, his classmate's Spiritual Root attributes were nearly identical to Chen Mobai's, making their capabilities roughly equivalent.

visual_description: A wide classroom shot, centered on a stern but subtly smiling homeroom teacher (Chai Deyun) at a podium, holding a sleek tablet. Two exceptionally composed students, Song Zheng and Yan Bingxuan, stand beside their desks in the front row, bathed in a soft glow, heads held high with a sense of quiet achievement. In the mid-ground, Chen Mobai sits with a deflated, envious expression, his puffed chest now slightly sunken, watching the praised students. Other students in the background are also looking towards Song Zheng and Yan Bingxuan, some with admiration, others with similar envy. The lighting emphasizes the two standing students, making them appear almost ethereal, contrasting with Chen Mobai's grounded disappointment. This is presented as a vibrant Chinese Manhua panel.
text_segment:
"Mm, not bad. Many of you have made progress during the holidays." 
The homeroom teacher, standing at the podium, had finished reviewing everyone's status panels. A rare smile broke through his typically stern expression.
He then called out each student who had shown improvement, praising them by name.
Chen Mobai was among those commended.
The teacher's praise caused the two beautiful classmates in front of him to turn around, and Chen Mobai couldn't help but puff out his chest, a smug look spreading across his face.
Reaching the Fifth-Stage Qi Refinement realm placed him firmly within the top twenty of the class.
Now in his final year of high school, if he pushed himself, he might even advance another stage before the Immortal Sect's college entrance exams.
Reaching the Sixth-Stage Qi Refinement realm would likely make the four top-tier Dao Academies unattainable, but he could still aspire to Second-Tier Dao Academies. As for Third-Tier Dao Academies—like the local Dan Zhu and Chi Xia Academies—admission seemed virtually guaranteed.
Entering a Dao Academy after the entrance exam would exempt him from conscription into the Immortal Sect's frontier wars for at least a decade, potentially giving him time to achieve Foundation Establishment.
"Finally, I want to give special commendation to Song Zheng and Yan Bingxuan," the teacher continued. "I never imagined I'd live to see two students reach the late stages of Qi Refinement under my tutelage."
Chai Deyun had just become the class teacher six years ago, and this was the first class he had seen through to graduation, a time when his emotions were at their peak. With a look of profound sentiment, he set down his tablet. His usually stern gaze suddenly softened as he, along with everyone in the classroom, turned to look at the two students who had stood up.
These were the class's top scholars and elite students with exceptional Spiritual Root attributes. As expected, they had lived up to expectations, reaching the Seventh-Stage Qi Refinement before the college entrance exams.
Such achievement practically guaranteed admission to a Second-Tier Dao Academy and the chance to attempt Foundation Establishment within a decade. Success would elevate them to Golden Core Dao Seed status, making them priority cultivation targets even within the Immortal Sect.
Chen Mobai watched with envy. Unlike his borderline True Spiritual Root, Song Zheng and Yan Bingxuan possessed genuine True Spiritual Roots, with one of their attribute affinities exceeding 40. Cultivating techniques aligned with that attribute would yield double the progress for half the effort.

visual_description: A dynamic, wide-angle Chinese Manhua panel capturing a chaotic dismissal scene. The homeroom teacher, Chai Deyun, stands at the podium, looking slightly exasperated as students burst from their desks. In the foreground, Chen Mobai, a blur of motion, is mid-leap out a large classroom window, his jade-like smartphone clutched in hand, a determined expression on his face. The school bell tower is visible in the background through the window, ringing out. Other students are scattering, pushing past each other in a frantic rush towards the exits. Motion lines and speed effects emphasize the urgency and speed of the students.
text_segment:
"Alright, class is dismissed for today," Chai Deyun announced after compiling the collected test papers, as the bell rang from the highest tower of the school.
The students immediately scattered in a frenzy.
Even Chen Mobai, grabbing only his phone, leapt out the nearby window and sprinted straight for the cultivation chamber.
Thanks to his secluded cultivation during the holiday, Chen Mobai's cultivation had advanced a level, and his Lightness Technique was now thirty percent faster. He arrived at the cultivation hall ahead of most of the others.

visual_description: A low-light, slightly claustrophobic Chinese Manhua panel focused on Chen Mobai inside a small, minimalist cultivation chamber. He holds his jade-like smartphone, displaying a 'Spiritual Energy Value: 10' reading. The chamber door, heavy and metallic, is slowly closing behind him, leaving a frustrated, blurred classmate outside, who is cursing under his breath and running towards another door. A subtle, ethereal glow emanates from the chamber's floor or walls, suggesting rising spiritual energy. The overall atmosphere is one of urgency and the quiet hum of advanced technology meeting ancient cultivation.
text_segment:
With no time to be picky, he spotted an empty cultivation room with its door ajar and rushed inside.
Chen Mobai swiped his electronic student ID from his phone against the reader at the chamber's entrance. The "Vacant" sign on the electronic display vanished instantly, and the door began to close slowly.
"Damn it!"
A classmate who arrived a moment too late cursed under his breath and scrambled toward another empty cultivation room.
Their urgency was understandable.
Spiritual energy was incredibly scarce.
After six thousand years of exploitation by the Immortal Sect, Diyuan Star's resources were nearly depleted. Within the territories occupied by the Thirty-Six Grotto-Heavens and Seventy-Two Blessed Lands, all Spiritual Veins and primordial qi had been nationalized. The residual spiritual energy lingering in the environment was barely sufficient for cultivators' basic breathing and meditation.
To cultivate using concentrated spiritual energy, practitioners had to pay the Immortal Sect in Merit Points.
First-Tier Low-Grade Earth Vein Spiritual Energy delivered to one's Cave Abode cost ten Merit Points per month.
As a Fifth-Stage Qi Refinement cultivator, Chen Mobai found First-Tier Low-Grade spiritual energy inadequate for his needs.
First-Tier Mid-Grade Earth Vein Spiritual Energy cost 20 Merit Points per month.
First-Tier High-Grade Earth Vein Spiritual Energy, on the other hand, required 40 Merit Points per month.
For Chen Mobai, the amount of First-Tier Mid-Grade Spiritual Energy was only enough to stabilize his cultivation and make barely noticeable progress. If he wanted to advance rapidly, First-Tier High-Grade was the better choice.
Of course, Second-Tier or even Third-Tier Earth Vein Spiritual Energy would be ideal.
But that was merely wishful thinking.
Sensing the spiritual energy concentration in his approximately three-square-meter cultivation chamber beginning to rise, Chen Mobai opened the spiritual energy measurement app on his phone.
After waiting nearly a minute, the reading finally stabilized.
Spiritual Energy Value: 10
The grade of Earth Vein Spiritual Energy could be measured using its spiritual energy value.
According to the Immortal Sect's regulations:
A spiritual energy value of 1-10 corresponded to a First-Tier Spiritual Vein.A spiritual energy value of 10-100 corresponded to a Second-Tier Spiritual Vein. * A spiritual energy value of 100-1000 corresponded to a Third-Tier Spiritual Vein...
And so on. The highest-grade Spiritual Vein in the entire Immortal Sect was said to be the Sixth-Tier Earth Vein within the Grotto-Heavens of the two Soul Transformation Patriarchs.
